title: The Stunt That Went Wrong
call: Inspector {name}, a stunt rope snapped on the set of the film 'Tiger Returns'.
The hero is in hospital. The director says it was no accident.
arrival: Lights, cameras and sixty crew members, all frozen. Nobody is shooting today.

briefing.label: Victim
briefing.value: Action hero Vikrant. Alive, with a broken leg.

briefing.label: Time
briefing.value: Around 9 AM, during the big stunt

examination.title: Examine the stunt rope

spots.title: Top end
spots.text: Tied tightly to the beam. The knot is perfect.

spots.title: Middle
spots.text: Half of the rope is cut neat and straight. The other half is torn.

spots.title: Harness
spots.text: The harness clip is fine. Not broken.

examination.question: Why did the rope snap?
examination.why: A neat cut halfway, then torn: someone cut it so it would hold for a moment, then snap in the middle of the stunt.

interview.alibi: I was in the makeup van, fixing the heroine's face all morning!
replies: Crew, yes. So are sixty other people on this set.
gotchas: This is your makeup powder on the ladder, Rani. The heroine says you left the van for twenty minutes!
Your headlamp is missing from your kit, Rani. It was up on the stunt beam!

interview.alibi: I was curling the villain's hair. That takes a full hour, darling!
replies: Powder on my hands, yes. But I never left the hair tent. Prakash was in my chair the whole time!
My headlamp is right here in my bag. Look, the batteries are still sealed.
interview.release: Villain actor Prakash was in Tony's chair for the whole hour.

interview.alibi: I was making chai for sixty people, sir. Ask anyone!
replies: Crew, sir. I'm the spot boy.
Makeup? My hands smell of ginger and tea, sir!
My headlamp is on my head, sir. I wear it in the dark storeroom.
interview.release: Sixty crew members got their chai from Chotu, one by one.

leads.from: ✂️ A neat, straight cut in the rope
leads.question: The cut is perfectly straight and clean. What made it?
wrongWhy: Rat bites are messy and chewed, not straight.
Heat would leave a black, melted end.
leads.reveal: Scissors! You check the costume table…
leads.name: Costume scissors
leads.found: **Costume scissors** with rope threads on the blades, and beige powder on the handles. Only the **CREW** can go behind the costume table.
leads.ask: Cross out everyone who is NOT crew.
leads.why: Cast and visitors aren't allowed behind the costume table.

leads.from: ✂️ Beige powder on the scissor handles
leads.question: The powder is soft, beige, and smells like face cream. What is it?
wrongWhy: Flour doesn't smell like face cream.
Cement is grey and gritty, not soft.
leads.reveal: Makeup! You follow powdery fingerprints to the ladder…
leads.name: Powdery fingerprints
leads.found: Powdery fingerprints all the way up the **ladder** to the dark stunt beam. The climber had **makeup on their hands**.
leads.ask: Tap everyone left with makeup on their hands.
leads.why: Rani and Tony both work with makeup.
leads.card: MAKEUP fingerprints on the stunt ladder

leads.from: 💄 The fingerprints go up into the dark
leads.question: The stunt beam is twenty feet up, in total darkness. How did the climber see the rope?
wrongWhy: A candle up there would set the curtains on fire.
Cutting exactly halfway? That's no guess.
leads.reveal: A headlamp! You climb up to the beam…
leads.name: Headlamp
leads.found: A **headlamp**, left on the beam in a hurry. Its strap is smeared with beige powder.
leads.ask: Cross out everyone left who does NOT carry a headlamp.
leads.why: Jojo uses his phone torch, not a headlamp.
leads.card: A HEADLAMP left on the stunt beam

confession: "He told the director to drop me after this film. 'Her makeup looks cheap,' in front of everyone. I wanted him to fall in front of everyone too."
escapeStory: Rani drove off in the makeup van. Police stopped it at the toll gate, still full of her powder.
